C1682.title: AUR atomic-lockfile Supply Chain Attack
C1682.summary: In June 2026, the Arch User Repository was reported to have atomic-lockfile supply-chain attack-related risk. The current references are insufficient to verify poisoning method, affected package count, or malware payload type, so specific claims such as more than 1,600 packages, stealers, or eBPF rootkits should not be included until technical analysis or advisory sources are added.
